At the back edge, a tall gridded windowpane glows with rich amber sunset light. Premium collectible product shot with soft highlights and no harsh reflections. Nothing extends beyond its edges: no horizon, sky or distant scenery behind it. Plain seamless soft neutral background with nothing else in it. Soft, even, diffuse light with only a gentle contact shadow; everything in crisp focus. No text, letters, numbers, signs or logos anywhere.
